china/taiwan-hkm.560319bf5545: Macao is the Macao Peninsula plus Taipa and Coloane islands — the sea between those two has been filled in to make Cotai, 路氹城. It covers only about thirty-three square kilometers, thirteen square miles, with about six hundred eighty thousand people, one of the most crowded places on Earth. Tourism is the backbone of its economy, and its Historic Centre became a World Heritage Site in two thousand five.
china/taiwan-hkm.dac28155351c: Taiwan Strait. about one hundred thirty kilometers wide at its narrowest, or eighty-one miles. The Taiwan Strait, 台湾海峡, separates Fujian from Taiwan Island. At its narrowest, from Pingtan Island to near Hsinchu, it is only about one hundred thirty kilometers wide, or eighty-one miles, roughly New York City to Philadelphia. It is shallow, mostly less than one hundred meters deep. In the last Ice Age, when sea level was much lower, it was dry land. It is a busy shipping lane between the East China Sea and the South China Sea. Narrowest about one hundred thirty kilometers: NYC to Philadelphia.
china/taiwan-hkm.4d35d975cb43: Trade across the strait is huge, and since two thousand eight there have been direct mail, trade and flights, the “Three Links”, 三通.
china/taiwan-hkm.88f72f5f5b52: Each strip of orange is new land. Totals are rough estimates — about seventy square kilometers reclaimed by about twenty sixteen, about six to seven percent of Hong Kong’s land — and in-between years are interpolated. In the US, Boston’s Back Bay and much of Lower Manhattan were made the same way.
china/taiwan-hkm.1e5d6c6671d9: Rainfall. Most of the island: over two thousand millimeters a year. Moist winds from the sea plus high mountains equals lots of rain, especially on the slopes the wind blows against, windward slopes. The northeast is wettest: Huoshaoliao averages over six thousand millimeters a year, or two hundred thirty-six inches. The Penghu Islands, low and flat in the strait, are much drier. Sea air plus mountains equals rain on the windward side.
china/taiwan-hkm.d45a846434e5: Taiwan Province is made up of Taiwan Island, the Penghu Islands, Diaoyu Dao, Chiwei Yu and other islands, and its short name is 台. Taiwan Island is China’s largest island. Spin the three D relief map, hover over the land to read the altitude, click places and switch on layers to finish the mission checklist below.
china/taiwan-hkm.4e69f0958ff8: Memory hint: Sea air plus mountains equals rain on the windward side.
china/taiwan-hkm.dd1c9842e35c: The Tropic of Cancer crosses the middle of the island, at about twenty-three point four degrees north. North of it: subtropical monsoon climate. South of it: tropical monsoon climate. Winters are warm, summers hot and rainy. Taipei’s January averages about sixteen degrees Celsius, sixty-one degrees Fahrenheit, like a winter day in central Florida, around Orlando.
china/taiwan-hkm.9d2a8c818d61: Macao’s land area roughly tripled in a century; today more than half of its land was once sea. Totals are approximate — about eleven point six square kilometers in nineteen twelve, about thirty-three point three square kilometers in twenty twenty-four — and in-between years are interpolated.

china/taiwan-hkm.43d6a8b6bae9: Keelung. Northern port, the “rainy port”. Keelung, 基隆, is the main port of northern Taiwan, serving Taipei. In winter the northeast monsoon blows straight off the sea, so it rains here very often: it is nicknamed the “rainy port”. Huoshaoliao, in the hills nearby, is one of the wettest places in China. Taiwan’s two big ports: Kaohsiung, south, and Keelung, north.
china/taiwan-hkm.47cd0d5675ec: two, Chapter seven “The Southern Region”, Section three “Pearls of the Orient: Hong Kong and Macao” and Section four “Sacred Territory of the Motherland: Taiwan Province”, section numbering varies slightly by edition.
china/taiwan-hkm.2a3ad1dbddc6: Taiwan Province. China’s largest island, about thirty-six thousand square kilometers, about twenty-three million people. Taiwan Province is Taiwan Island plus the Penghu Islands, Diaoyu Dao, Chiwei Yu and other islands. Its capital city is Taipei. It lies off China’s southeast coast, across the Taiwan Strait from Fujian, with the Pacific Ocean to the east. Size check: a little smaller than Maryland and Delaware put together, about fourteen thousand square miles. Taiwan has been an inseparable part of China’s territory since ancient times.
china/taiwan-hkm.bd3861d8036b: Memory hint: Yushan three thousand nine hundred fifty-two meters: number one in the east.

china/taiwan-hkm.e91dc070249e: Typhoons. Mostly July to September. Typhoons form over the warm Pacific and often hit Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao in summer and autumn. They bring fierce winds and torrential rain: floods, landslides and damage to crops. But typhoon rain also fills reservoirs. The east coast and the mountain slopes facing the wind get the most. Typhoon: wind and rain; windward slopes get soaked.
china/taiwan-hkm.1eac4b5f7738: Taiwan’s plains lie mostly along the west coast; the Jianan Plain is the largest, 嘉南平原 in Chinese.

china/taiwan-hkm.36d4df965713: At noon on the June solstice the Sun is straight overhead here. Taiwan’s south is closer to the equator than Key West, Florida, twenty-four point five degrees north.
china/taiwan-hkm.f80c0b75f481: Hong Kong returned on July first, nineteen ninety-seven.
china/taiwan-hkm.86148d9d61d3: Western plains. Rice, sugar cane, fruit, and most of the cities. Taiwan’s plains lie mostly along the west coast; the Jianan Plain, 嘉南平原, is the largest. Warm and wet: rice gives two or three crops a year; sugar cane, tea and tropical fruit, bananas, pineapples, mangoes, thrive. Taiwan is called a “home of fruit”. Most people, cities, highways and railways crowd onto this flat western strip. West: plains, rice, fruit, cities.
china/taiwan-hkm.46f08562b376: Size check: a little smaller than Maryland and Delaware put together, about fourteen thousand square miles.
china/taiwan-hkm.0036340f344c: Hong Kong International Airport opened in nineteen ninety-eight on a platform made by flattening two small islands and filling the sea around them. The islands are Chek Lap Kok and Lam Chau. In twenty twenty-four a third runway, also on reclaimed land, came fully into use.
china/taiwan-hkm.d6cbf11ef3ba: Taipei. Largest city, in the Taipei Basin. Taipei sits in a basin in the north, ringed by hills. It is Taiwan’s biggest city and its centre of business and culture. Its five hundred eight-meter, one thousand six hundred sixty-seven-foot, Taipei one oh one tower was the world’s tallest building from two thousand four to twenty ten. Taipei: a city in a bowl of hills.
china/taiwan-hkm.91abf7268736: Hong Kong and Macao are China’s two special administrative regions, 特别行政区, run under “one country, two systems”. Hong Kong returned to China on July first, nineteen ninety-seven, and Macao returned on December twentieth, nineteen ninety-nine. Both are crowded and short of flat land, so they keep making new land by filling in the sea: 填海造地. Drag the time slider and watch the coastline march out into the water.
china/taiwan-hkm.7559a81018f6: The Taiwan Strait separates Fujian from Taiwan Island; the strait is called 台湾海峡 in Chinese. At its narrowest, from Pingtan Island to near Hsinchu, it is only about one hundred thirty kilometers wide, about eighty-one miles, roughly New York City to Philadelphia.
china/taiwan-hkm.b6e3dbe79778: Sea on every side. The summer monsoon, the winter northeast monsoon and typhoons all carry moist air, and the high mountains force that air upward, so the windward slopes get soaked. Most of the island gets over two thousand millimeters a year, seventy-nine inches. Huoshaoliao in the northeast, 火烧寮, averages over six thousand millimeters, two hundred thirty-six inches, one of the wettest places in China. Seattle gets about thirty-nine inches.

china/taiwan-hkm.5a1613bd8f46: Alishan. Sunrise over a sea of clouds. Alishan, 阿里山, is a mountain area famous for five sights: sunrise, the sea of clouds, sunset glow, forest and its mountain railway. The narrow-gauge Alishan Forest Railway was built in the early nineteen hundreds to haul timber, climbing from the plain at Chiayi to over two thousand meters, six thousand six hundred feet. Giant ancient cypress trees grow here; some are thousands of years old. Alishan’s five wonders: sunrise, clouds, sunset, forest, railway.
china/taiwan-hkm.0992a5bac4c6: Squares are drawn to scale by area. Taiwan Province is almost as big as Maryland and Delaware together. Hong Kong would fit into Rhode Island’s land about two and a half times, dashed: Rhode Island with its bays. Macao is a speck: about half the size of Manhattan.
china/taiwan-hkm.5b5af11de984: Tropic of Cancer, about twenty-three point four degrees north
china/taiwan-hkm.e37426c06fb8: Kaohsiung. Largest port, export processing zone. Kaohsiung, 高雄, in the southwest is Taiwan’s largest port and a centre of heavy industry: steel, shipbuilding and petrochemicals. It opened an export processing zone in nineteen sixty-six: factories import materials, process them and export the products. This “process and export” model is how Taiwan, with few raw materials, built its economy. Kaohsiung: biggest port, steel and ships.
china/taiwan-hkm.bbf9daaf1e76: Fujian Province. Same roots, same language. Most people in Taiwan have family roots in Fujian and Guangdong. Both sides speak Mandarin, Minnan, Hokkien, and Hakka, eat similar food and keep the same festivals. Fujian and Taiwan trade heavily; since two thousand eight there have been direct mail, trade and flights across the strait, the “Three Links”. Same roots, same language, same festivals.
china/taiwan-hkm.4ed3d4b7cc24: Yushan, Jade Mountain. Three thousand nine hundred fifty-two meters, twelve thousand nine hundred sixty-six feet: highest peak in eastern China. Yushan, 玉山, “Jade Mountain”, is Taiwan’s highest peak and the highest in eastern China. It sits almost exactly on the Tropic of Cancer, yet its summit gets snow in winter: height beats latitude. It is almost twice as high as Mount Mitchell, six thousand six hundred eighty-four feet, the tallest peak in the eastern US. Yushan three thousand nine hundred fifty-two meters: number one in the east.

The two sides speak the same languages — Mandarin, Minnan or Hokkien, Hakka — celebrate the same festivals — Spring Festival, Mid-Autumn — and honour Mazu, a sea goddess whose temple tradition began on Meizhou Island in Fujian.

The Tropic of Cancer crosses central Taiwan, near Chiayi in the west and Hualien in the east. North of it: subtropical monsoon climate. South of it: tropical monsoon climate. At noon on the June solstice the Sun is straight overhead here. Taiwan’s south is closer to the equator than Key West, Florida, twenty-four point five degrees north. North: subtropical. South: tropical.

china/taiwan-hkm.5a52845db2f1: Penghu Islands. About ninety islands in the strait. The Penghu Islands, 澎湖, lie in the Taiwan Strait, between Fujian and Taiwan Island. They are low, flat and very windy in winter, with little rain: much drier than Taiwan Island. Fishing is the traditional way of life. Penghu: flat, windy, dry islands in the strait.

china/taiwan-hkm.7b98480827e3: Hsinchu Science Park. Electronics and computer chips. Opened in nineteen eighty, the Hsinchu Science Park, 新竹, is the heart of Taiwan’s high-tech electronics industry. Factories here make semiconductor chips that end up in phones, cars and computers worldwide. Chips need very clean water and power, skilled engineers and good ports and airports nearby. Hsinchu equals chips.
china/taiwan-hkm.721b0d6736a1: The Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge, about fifty-five kilometers long, about thirty-four miles, opened in twenty eighteen. It is a chain of bridges, an undersea tunnel and artificial islands. Together with nine cities in Guangdong’s Pearl River Delta, Hong Kong and Macao form the Guangdong Hong Kong Macao Greater Bay Area.
china/taiwan-hkm.9480307d5c6e: Hong Kong is made up of Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and the New Territories: about one thousand one hundred square kilometers, four hundred thirty square miles, and about seven point five million people. Victoria Harbour is deep and sheltered, and Hong Kong is a world centre of finance, trade and shipping, and a famous place to shop.

China is: high in the west, low in the east, dropping in three great steps from the Tibetan Plateau down to the sea. The Tibetan Plateau, 青藏高原, is the “Roof of the World”, higher than almost every mountain top in the lower forty-eight states. Spin the three D model, switch on the step colours, and drag the cross-section to walk down the stairs.

china/territory.c7db322a5dd1: Location. Eastern and Northern Hemispheres, East Asia, west coast of the Pacific. Hemispheres: China is in both the Eastern and the Northern Hemisphere. Land-sea position: in eastern Asia, on the west coast of the Pacific Ocean. The east faces the ocean, the west reaches deep into Eurasia. Latitude: it spans nearly fifty degrees of latitude. Most of China is in the north temperate zone, a small southern part is in the tropics, and none is in a frigid zone. The Tropic of Cancer crosses Taiwan, Guangdong, Guangxi and Yunnan at twenty-three point five degrees north. Advantages: land and sea both help transport and links with the world; mostly temperate, so the climate suits farming and living. Tropic of Cancer, east, west: Taiwan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, 台粤桂滇.

china/territory.6e73db931fa1: Suggestions: one, run the guided tour in order: location, area, neighbours, seas, divisions; two, pairs quiz each other with the hidden-column table; three, use the game’s “seat” mode as a class contest. The map is schematic, drawn from standard-map data, and includes Taiwan Province and the South China Sea Islands.
china/territory.2344f08d772a: China lies between about seventy-three degrees east and one hundred thirty-five degrees east, and between four degrees north and fifty-three degrees north.
china/territory.691e24e08a86: 冀 equals Hebei, 鄂 equals Hubei, 鲁 equals Shandong.
china/territory.b14325ff29af: Two special administrative regions, S A R's: Hong Kong and Macao, under “one country, two systems”
china/territory.9b05a0228f4d: Shanghai, about thirty-one degrees north, about Jacksonville, Florida
china/territory.aff1dca529fb: Latitude: it spans nearly fifty degrees of latitude. Most of China is in the north temperate zone, a small southern part is in the tropics, and none is in a frigid zone.
china/territory.848aa54d392f: Supports the twenty twenty-two Compulsory-Education Geography Curriculum Standard, theme “Understanding China”: describe China’s location and its advantages, specifying hemispheres, land-sea position, and latitude; know its territory, and locate the thirty-four provincial-level divisions with their short names and seats. Textbook: P E P Geography Grade eight Volume one, Chapter one “China in the World”, Section one “Territory”.
china/territory.3cb6e99ea81f: China is about five thousand two hundred kilometers wide, about three thousand two hundred miles, farther than New York to San Francisco. The sun rises over the far east more than four hours before it reaches the Pamir Plateau in the far west. Yet the whole country uses Beijing Time, so in Xinjiang schools simply start later by the clock.

china/three-gorges.2118428fba06: Simplified model, approximate: installed capacity twenty-two thousand five hundred megawatts; flood-control storage between one hundred forty-five meters and one hundred seventy-five meters about twenty-two point one five billion cubic meters, total storage about thirty-nine point three billion cubic meters; power about nine point eight one times zero point nine times flow times head; a “safe” downstream release of about fifty-five thousand cubic meters per second is assumed.
china/three-gorges.4fc6ac2da224: Nanjing. Nanjing, 南京, an ancient capital, sits on the lower river. Ocean-going ships can sail upstream as far as here.
china/three-gorges.92d4d62726d0: Hukou: end of the middle reaches. Hukou, 湖口, “lake mouth”, in Jiangxi, where Poyang Lake — China’s largest freshwater lake — joins, divides the middle and lower reaches.
china/three-gorges.3ec7c4606dbc: Like a connected vessel, 连通器: open the valve, levels even out, then the gate opens.
china/three-gorges.35c1c2fb1a6b: Hoover: two hundred twenty-one meters, about two thousand eighty megawatts. Three Gorges: one hundred eighty-one meters, twenty-two thousand five hundred megawatts.
china/three-gorges.c70d051db07a: In flood season the reservoir is kept low, about one hundred forty-five meters. Why?
china/three-gorges.e454da22e042: The Yangtze begins as melt-water from glaciers on Geladaindong, 各拉丹冬, six thousand six hundred twenty-one meters, the highest peak of the Tanggula Mountains on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. The source stream is the Tuotuo River.
china/three-gorges.616416208718: The reservoir can be set anywhere from one hundred forty-five meters to one hundred seventy-five meters above sea level. Higher water stores more and makes more power — but leaves less room to catch a flood. Pick a season and a level and watch the readouts; then send in a flood and see if the dam can hold it.
china/three-gorges.83883af0224c: At Shigu in Yunnan the river makes a sudden U-turn — the “First Bend of the Yangtze”. Just below, it races through Tiger Leaping Gorge, 虎跳峡, one of the deepest gorges in the world.
china/three-gorges.7c279a961e50: The dam leaves the water upstream about one hundred thirteen meters higher than downstream. Ships have two ways up: one, the double-lane, five-step ship locks, 双线五级船闸 — a staircase of five water “steps” that takes several big ships at once but needs about three and a half hours; two, the ship lift, 升船机 — a giant elevator, about forty minutes, but one ship of up to three thousand tons at a time. Tap a ship, then tap “Locks” or “Lift”.
china/three-gorges.4f203bbec4a6: Yichang: end of the upper reaches. Yichang, 宜昌, marks the end of the upper reaches, about four thousand five hundred kilometers. Here the river leaves the mountains for the flat Jianghan Plain.
china/three-gorges.fc018efe4c4f: Drag the slider to float downstream, or press. The chart is the river’s profile — watch it drop from a glacier five thousand four hundred meters up, or seventeen thousand seven hundred feet, all the way to sea level. Answer the question at each checkpoint!
china/three-gorges.5ae6e6f71785: The reservoir must be at one hundred forty-five meters
china/three-gorges.0b801400635b: Thirty-two big generators make roughly one hundred billion kilowatt-hours a year, with a capacity of twenty-two thousand five hundred megawatts — clean power that would otherwise come largely from burning coal.
china/three-gorges.4fe7ec317eaf: How do you lift a three-thousand-ton ship one hundred thirteen meters, or three hundred seventy feet — as high as a thirty-seven-storey building — in about forty minutes? The answer is on the Yangtze River, right next to the biggest power station on Earth.
china/three-gorges.16b75d51d5a7: Each chamber of the five-step locks is two hundred eighty meters long and thirty-four meters wide — longer than two and a half football fields.
china/three-gorges.c252036641a3: Extension material, approximate, simplified for teaching: distances and heights on the profile; the storage curve and the power formula, with storage of about seventeen point one five billion cubic meters at one hundred forty-five meters, about thirty-nine point three billion cubic meters at one hundred seventy-five meters; the “safe release about fifty-five thousand cubic meters per second” and the two floods are teaching scenarios, not the real operating rules; convoy timings, about three point
china/three-gorges.79e3366d7d6e: The Jing River bends and Dongting Lake. Below Yichang the river slows and wanders in tight loops — the Jing River stretch, 荆江, nicknamed “nine twists of the intestine”, 九曲回肠. Water drains slowly, so this is where floods are most dangerous.
china/three-gorges.032aca6132ab: three, use the benefits and challenges panel for a structured debate on weighing gains and costs and sustainable development; four, link the locks to the physics idea of connected vessels, 连通器.
china/three-gorges.dc6f1e8586a9: Mission one: ride the Yangtze from source to sea
china/three-gorges.18f7edb7c144: Supports the twenty twenty-two Compulsory-Education Geography Curriculum Standard, “Understanding China”: use maps and data to describe the main features of the Yangtze and its influence on society and the economy, and explain why water resources should be developed and used wisely. Textbook: P E P Geography Grade eight Volume one, Chapter two, Section three, Rivers, developing the Yangtze;
china/three-gorges.cebb9f45a4da: five hours per lockage, about forty minutes per lift trip, are simplified — in reality several groups follow each other up the lock staircase; comparison values are commonly quoted approximations.
china/three-gorges.37a2d2d6acc9: Mission three: get the convoy past the dam
china/three-gorges.efbcbddf18e9: First Bend and Tiger Leaping Gorge. At Shigu in Yunnan the river makes a sudden U-turn — the “First Bend of the Yangtze”. Just below, it races through Tiger Leaping Gorge, 虎跳峡, one of the deepest gorges in the world.
china/three-gorges.98b26b731127: the benefits and problems of the Three Gorges Project can be linked to the regional units of Grade eight Volume two. Sections vary by printing. The English compares with the Mississippi and Hoover Dam for US students.
china/three-gorges.a53f65f9b414: Shanghai: into the East China Sea. After about six thousand three hundred kilometers, three thousand nine hundred miles, the Yangtze reaches the East China Sea at Shanghai. It is the longest river in Asia and the third longest in the world.
china/three-gorges.daeb63bf3a50: The reservoir can catch about twenty-two billion cubic meters of floodwater. The flood standard of the Jing River stretch rose from about once in ten years to once in one hundred years.
china/three-gorges.f4d73ef7bb6a: Lengths and average flow at the mouth are commonly quoted approximate values. Sources differ a little. The Mississippi alone is about three thousand seven hundred thirty kilometers; with the Missouri, about six thousand two hundred seventy-five kilometers.
china/three-gorges.d4ce18176d7c: The deep, calm reservoir drowned dangerous rapids. Ten-thousand-ton barge fleets can now reach Chongqing.
china/three-gorges.f55f6f29ab10: The glacier tongue is about five thousand four hundred meters up, about seventeen thousand seven hundred feet — higher than any mountaintop in the lower forty-eight US states. Mount Whitney is four thousand four hundred twenty-one meters.
china/three-gorges.56bd5c7b7747: Yibin: “the first city on the Yangtze”. The Min River joins at Yibin, 宜宾, in Sichuan. From here on the river is called the Chang Jiang, 长江, “long river”, and bigger boats can sail.
china/three-gorges.d0ecddcc114f: Chongqing: the mountain city. Chongqing, 重庆, where the Jialing River joins, is the biggest port on the upper Yangtze. The Three Gorges reservoir stretches all the way back here — about six hundred sixty kilometers from the dam, or four hundred ten miles, roughly Washington, DC to Boston.
china/three-gorges.334c7c82b4d2: Your mission: ride six thousand three hundred kilometers from a glacier on the Tibetan Plateau down to Shanghai, a distance of three thousand nine hundred miles; run the Three Gorges reservoir through flood season; then operate the giant ship locks and ship lift to get a convoy past the dam as fast as possible. Collect all nine stars to rise from Deckhand to Chief Engineer!
china/three-gorges.cc513793249e: Dams block fish such as the Chinese sturgeon from swimming upstream to spawn. The sturgeon’s name in Chinese is 中华鲟. China breeds and releases young sturgeon, built fish-protection areas, and in twenty twenty-one began a ten-year fishing ban on the Yangtze.
china/three-gorges.4901d3b97bc6: Source: Geladaindong glacier. The Yangtze begins as melt-water from glaciers on Geladaindong, 各拉丹冬, six thousand six hundred twenty-one meters, the highest peak of the Tanggula Mountains on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. The source stream is the Tuotuo River.
china/three-gorges.329f0bbf9932: Mission two: flood alert! Run the Three Gorges reservoir
china/three-gorges.7765af0a88a5: Qutang Gorge — the first gorge. The Three Gorges, 长江三峡, run about one hundred ninety-three kilometers from Baidicheng, 白帝城, to Nanjinguan near Yichang. First comes Qutang Gorge, 瞿塘峡: only about eight kilometers long, but the narrowest and most dramatic.

china/unity-diplomacy.8295cd46711e: At midnight on July first, nineteen ninety-seven, the Chinese flag rose over Hong Kong. The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region was set up, keeping its capitalist system and way of life. S A R for short.
china/unity-diplomacy.4ca4843c10f5: March two thousand five: China’s legislature passed a law against splitting the country. In April the leader of Taiwan’s Kuomintang party visited the mainland.
china/unity-diplomacy.ddb318d4678e: Twenty nineteen: the Shandong, 山东舰, the first carrier built entirely in China, entered service.
china/unity-diplomacy.c0df7a763ca5: September nineteen sixty-five. With it, China had all five of today’s autonomous regions.
china/unity-diplomacy.962cb88f6668: Memory hook: Hong Kong ninety-seven in summer, Macao ninety-nine in winter.
china/unity-diplomacy.015075fc5902: December twentieth, nineteen ninety-nine: China resumed exercising sovereignty over Macao, and the Macao S A R was set up.
china/unity-diplomacy.15802cd46541: Don’t mix up: nineteen fifty-one equals peaceful liberation of Tibet; nineteen sixty-five equals Tibet Autonomous Region founded.
china/unity-diplomacy.4526d4d17131: On May first, nineteen forty-seven — two years before the People’s Republic itself — Inner Mongolia became China’s first provincial-level autonomous region.
china/unity-diplomacy.9b863a6c98a4: In twenty fifteen the PLA’s “Second Artillery Corps” was renamed the…
china/unity-diplomacy.4deef1a7bf2f: Two organisations speaking for the two sides of the Taiwan Strait reached a shared understanding: both sides uphold the one-China principle. It is called the “nineteen ninety-two Consensus”, 九二共识.
china/unity-diplomacy.8598a1511d8f: Don’t mix up: The nineteen seventy-two communiqué began normalisation; it did not establish diplomatic relations.
china/unity-diplomacy.1a8fd7abf136: Memory hook: Fifty-five — the biggest arrives.
china/unity-diplomacy.c86e5e1b9d0f: Suggested use: students drag the slider to fill in a table of the five autonomous regions and their founding dates, compare the return dates of Hong Kong and Macao, then use the ordering and sort games to fix the three stages of diplomacy, nineteen fifties: opening doors; nineteen seventies: breakthroughs; after nineteen seventy-eight: all-round diplomacy.
china/unity-diplomacy.0e252d64d70c: Beijing. Capital of China. February nineteen seventy-two: Chairman Mao Zedong met President Nixon here. Twenty fourteen: Beijing hosted the APEC leaders’ meeting. Twenty seventeen: the first Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation.
china/unity-diplomacy.78716290654c: First Chief Executive: Edmund Ho, 何厚铧. The regional flag shows a lotus flower.
china/unity-diplomacy.8688f1bb0952: Deng Xiaoping proposed “one country, two systems”, 一国两制. His name in Chinese is 邓小平. In December nineteen eighty-four China and Britain signed a Joint Declaration: China would resume exercising sovereignty over Hong Kong on July first, nineteen ninety-seven.
china/unity-diplomacy.30e71fb20b49: October first, nineteen fifty-five, in China’s far northwest.
china/unity-diplomacy.3f03f289829e: Memory hook: Five regions in order: Inner Mongolia forty-seven, Xinjiang fifty-five, Guangxi and Ningxia fifty-eight, Tibet sixty-five.
china/unity-diplomacy.bfad1d27f6ed: The two sides of the Strait opened direct postal, air and shipping links — the “three direct links”, 三通.
china/unity-diplomacy.3a0c53e068b1: Memory hook: Nineteen seventy-one UN, nineteen seventy-two Nixon and Japan, nineteen seventy-nine US relations.
china/unity-diplomacy.9e22d14b1bcb: Taiwan Province. Cross-Strait relations since nineteen seventy-nine. The textbook teaches that Taiwan has been part of China since ancient times; the two sides of the Strait have been separated since nineteen forty-nine. Nineteen seventy-nine: policy of peaceful reunification. Nineteen eighty-seven: family visits begin. Nineteen ninety-two: the “nineteen ninety-two Consensus” on the one-China principle. Two thousand five: Anti-Secession Law. Two thousand eight: direct mail, flights and shipping. Twenty fifteen: the two sides’ leaders meet.
china/unity-diplomacy.27430332a20a: Don’t mix up: Guangxi in March nineteen fifty-eight came before Ningxia in October nineteen fifty-eight.
china/unity-diplomacy.297f4c20e7eb: China’s first aircraft carrier, which entered service in twenty twelve, is the…
china/unity-diplomacy.51cfeb2e4790: July two thousand six: the Qinghai-Tibet Railway opened all the way to Lhasa — the highest railway on Earth, part of a drive to develop western China.
china/unity-diplomacy.13db024e6a19: In April nineteen fifty-five, twenty-nine Asian and African countries met in Bandung, Indonesia — the first such conference with no colonial powers present. When arguments broke out, Zhou Enlai proposed “seeking common ground while setting aside differences” and helped the meeting succeed. The phrase in Chinese is 求同存异.
china/unity-diplomacy.4cbd2bda046e: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Founded March nineteen fifty-eight. The Zhuang are China’s largest ethnic minority. The only autonomous region on the sea coast, next to Vietnam. Famous for the limestone peaks of Guilin.
china/unity-diplomacy.6d7702eaf8a5: In October nineteen seventy-one, the twenty-sixth UN General Assembly…
china/unity-diplomacy.42b9919fd574: Twenty twelve: China’s first aircraft carrier, the Liaoning, 辽宁舰, entered service.
china/unity-diplomacy.deda15098e0c: Hong Kong SAR. Returned July first, nineteen ninety-seven. Britain took Hong Kong in stages after the Opium War, eighteen forty-two, eighteen sixty, eighteen ninety-eight. July first, nineteen ninety-seven: China resumed exercising sovereignty. Hong Kong keeps its capitalist system — “Hong Kong people administering Hong Kong” with a high degree of autonomy. First Chief Executive: Tung Chee-hwa, 董建华. The regional flag shows a bauhinia flower.
china/unity-diplomacy.2933dea0016a: Drag the year slider, nineteen forty-seven to twenty nineteen. Regions light up when an autonomous region is founded or when Hong Kong and Macao return; the card below tells you what happened that year. Click anywhere on the map for details, and use the buttons to switch layers on and off.
china/unity-diplomacy.527760e004b7: Who first put forward the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence, in nineteen fifty-three?
china/unity-diplomacy.2a75ec195da8: Founded April twenty-third, nineteen forty-nine, at Baimamiao, Taizhou, Jiangsu Province.
china/unity-diplomacy.eae0e1d807fa: Each round shows six events in China’s diplomacy. Click them from earliest to latest to place them on the timeline. You score only when your first click is right.
china/unity-diplomacy.e7bb071372af: Don’t mix up: Hong Kong: Britain, nineteen ninety-seven. Macao: Portugal, nineteen ninety-nine.
china/unity-diplomacy.db31f18817ea: March nineteen fifty-eight: the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. October nineteen fifty-eight: the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.
china/unity-diplomacy.4ee5da9c1c68: This lesson follows China’s national History Curriculum Standard for Compulsory Education and the facts, dates and wording of the national unified-edition textbook Chinese History, Grade eight Volume two: Unit four “Ethnic Unity and National Reunification” and Unit five “National Defense and Diplomatic Achievements”. Lesson numbers vary slightly by printing. The standard is the twenty twenty-two edition.
china/unity-diplomacy.d1e80b638f86: Tibet Autonomous Region. Founded September nineteen sixty-five. The last of the five to be founded. Tibet had been peacefully liberated in nineteen fifty-one. Average height above four thousand meters, thirteen thousand feet — nearly as high as the tallest peaks of the Rocky Mountains. Two thousand six: the Qinghai-Tibet Railway reached Lhasa.
china/unity-diplomacy.6b64e39cecf5: Portugal gradually occupied Macao from the mid-fifteen hundreds.
china/unity-diplomacy.0bdf16b559f2: In nineteen forty-nine the United States refused to recognise the new People’s Republic of China. In nineteen seventy-two a US president flew across the Pacific to Beijing. Inside the same country live fifty-six ethnic groups, five autonomous regions, and two cities that run on a different economic system. How did all of that come about? Drag the year slider and watch it unfold on the map.
china/unity-diplomacy.1b83fe7a4c6c: Don’t mix up: Nixon’s nineteen seventy-two visit only began to normalise China-US relations; the two countries formally established diplomatic relations on January first, nineteen seventy-nine. And “one country, two systems” was first thought of for Taiwan, but first put into practice in Hong Kong.
china/unity-diplomacy.d1fbce51d85d: China has thirty-four provincial-level regions. Think US states. Five of them are autonomous regions, 自治区, where a large ethnic minority helps govern local affairs; two are special administrative regions, 特别行政区, Hong Kong and Macao.
china/unity-diplomacy.24654991f4bc: The “J” stands for jiān, 歼, short for “fighter”.
china/unity-diplomacy.8705804d874d: Macao followed on December twentieth, nineteen ninety-nine.
china/unity-diplomacy.bf7e1b5e6ef2: Macao SAR. Returned December twentieth, nineteen ninety-nine. Portugal gradually occupied Macao from the mid-fifteen hundreds. December twentieth, nineteen ninety-nine: China resumed exercising sovereignty; “Macao people administering Macao”. First Chief Executive: Edmund Ho, 何厚铧. The regional flag shows a lotus flower.
china/unity-diplomacy.80099f465c74: Before nineteen forty-nine the People’s Liberation Army was almost entirely foot soldiers. The army is called PLA for short, and 中国人民解放军 in Chinese. Then a navy, an air force and a missile force were added. Open each card to see that service’s story.
china/unity-diplomacy.7e1601f8c31c: Memory hook: Nineteen fifty-eight: Guangxi in March, Ningxia in October.
china/unity-diplomacy.c48f3875ade4: October twenty-fifth, nineteen seventy-one: the twenty-sixth UN General Assembly voted by a large majority to restore all the lawful rights of the People’s Republic of China in the UN, including its permanent seat on the Security Council.
china/unity-diplomacy.7ae79974b86e: Memory hook: Shanghai: a communiqué in seventy-two, two summits in two thousand one.
china/unity-diplomacy.41bb36e8786f: Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Founded October nineteen fifty-eight. The smallest autonomous region — about the size of West Virginia. The Yellow River waters its plain, a green strip in dry country. The Hui are a largely Muslim ethnic group who speak Chinese.
china/unity-diplomacy.5962a5c61449: October sixteenth, nineteen sixty-four: China tested its first atomic bomb. In nineteen sixty-six it tested a nuclear-armed missile and set up a strategic missile force.
china/unity-diplomacy.44b6bcbb21d9: Compare: the US Navy dates from seventeen seventy-five, so China’s modern navy is very young.
china/unity-diplomacy.419609982747: October sixteenth, nineteen sixty-four: China became the fifth country with nuclear weapons, and promised never to be the first to use them.
china/unity-diplomacy.e0c2521e0c62: The “nineteen ninety-two Consensus” is the shared understanding that both sides of the Taiwan Strait…
china/unity-diplomacy.4388828b8002: Memory hook: Order of the five: forty-seven, fifty-five, fifty-eight, fifty-eight, sixty-five.
china/unity-diplomacy.daa65bc117cb: The twentieth of December, nineteen ninety-nine: China resumed exercising sovereignty; “Macao people administering Macao”.
china/unity-diplomacy.d69fd4f13512: The English is written for US middle-schoolers new to Chinese history: key terms carry pinyin and a meaning, with familiar anchors, the size of Alaska, the age of the US Navy. A useful discussion: compare how the textbook describes Nixon’s nineteen seventy-two visit with how a US textbook describes it.
china/unity-diplomacy.2ea1218b953c: Memory hook: July first, ninety-seven — the bauhinia blooms.
china/unity-diplomacy.9b9732eef798: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. Founded May first, nineteen forty-seven. China’s first provincial-level autonomous region — set up two years before the People’s Republic. A long arc of grassland across the north: about one point one eight million square kilometers, bigger than Texas and California together. “Autonomous” means the local ethnic group helps run local affairs, inside one united country.
china/unity-diplomacy.677de4aa30c7: Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region. Founded October first, nineteen fifty-five. China’s largest provincial-level region: about one point six six million square kilometers — nearly the size of Alaska. On the old Silk Road, bordering eight countries. Home to Uygur, Han, Kazakh, Hui and dozens of other ethnic groups.
china/unity-diplomacy.dec8a8e57afd: Which autonomous region was founded last, in nineteen sixty-five?
china/unity-diplomacy.1646284f9117: January first, nineteen seventy-nine: full diplomatic relations at last. The US recognised the government of the People’s Republic as the sole legal government of China.
china/unity-diplomacy.480d6c3ab48a: Don’t mix up: Nixon’s visit in nineteen seventy-two is not the same as establishing relations in nineteen seventy-nine.
china/unity-diplomacy.ac172bbb5756: Don’t mix up: It was founded in nineteen forty-seven — before nineteen forty-nine, not after.
china/unity-diplomacy.38da3abe88b0: February nineteen seventy-two: US President Richard Nixon flew to Beijing — after more than twenty years of hostility and no diplomatic relations. In Shanghai the two sides issued a Joint Communiqué. China-US relations began to normalise.
china/unity-diplomacy.189de7d62429: Memory hook: Seventy-nine message, eighty-seven visits, ninety-two consensus.
china/unity-diplomacy.73cb221e9116: At the nineteen fifty-five Bandung Conference, Zhou Enlai won support with the idea of…
china/unity-diplomacy.650d5933474b: Shanghai. China’s largest city. February nineteen seventy-two: China and the US issued their Joint Communiqué here — often called the Shanghai Communiqué. Two thousand one: Shanghai hosted the APEC leaders’ meeting. Two thousand one: the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation was founded here.
china/unity-diplomacy.c104cb6f6cd5: Meeting a delegation from India, Premier Zhou Enlai first set out five rules for how countries should treat each other: respect each other’s sovereignty and territory, do not attack each other, do not interfere in each other’s internal affairs, deal as equals for mutual benefit, and coexist in peace. His name in Chinese is 周恩来.
china/unity-diplomacy.a2e1b6995f6f: September nineteen seventy-two: Japan’s prime minister Tanaka Kakuei visited; China and Japan established diplomatic relations. In the nineteen seventies dozens of countries did the same.
china/unity-diplomacy.4878ebf8db95: Formed in nineteen sixty-six as the “Second Artillery Corps”; renamed the Rocket Force on December thirty-first, twenty fifteen.
china/unity-diplomacy.53cd2b730876: It moved from copying foreign designs to its own: the J one zero and the stealthy J two zero fighters and the big Y two zero transport plane.
china/unity-diplomacy.9feac06d381a: April nineteen eighty-seven: China and Portugal signed a Joint Declaration on Macao. That year the Taiwan authorities let residents visit relatives on the mainland — ending nearly thirty-eight years of separation.
china/unity-diplomacy.700ec6514eed: The Shandong was the first carrier built in China, twenty nineteen.
china/unity-diplomacy.7fd6849551c2: April twenty-third, nineteen forty-nine: the People’s Navy was founded. November eleventh: the air force followed. On October first the People’s Republic of China was founded.

china/xia-shang-zhou.8929adf28912: Pangeng, about thirteen hundred B C E
china/xia-shang-zhou.2ebcf8fe72bb: About ten forty-six B C E King Wu of Zhou defeated King Zhou of Shang at the Battle of Muye. The Shang fell and the Western Zhou began, with its capital at Haojing, near Xi’an.
china/xia-shang-zhou.0cb95be93edb: Could you read a note written three thousand years ago? In China, people still can. Meet China’s first three dynasties, ruling families: the Xia, 夏, the Shang, 商, and the Western Zhou, 西周, about twenty seventy to seven hundred seventy-one B C E — the age of Egypt’s pharaoh Tutankhamun and the Trojan War. Turn two bronze treasures, then drag the year slider.
china/xia-shang-zhou.46bd0a7066e5: Four rams. The rams’ bodies form the belly; their heads stick out. A ram stands at each of the four corners; its curled horns and head project from the shoulder. Late Shang dynasty; unearthed at Ningxiang, Hunan; fifty-eight point three centimeters tall. Its unusual shape and exquisite craft make it a masterpiece of Shang bronze casting.
china/xia-shang-zhou.830155c0364a: Inscription “后母戊”. Three characters cast inside the wall. The inner wall carries three characters: Hou Mu Wu. A Shang king had it cast to offer sacrifices to his mother, named “Wu”. Characters cast on bronzes are called bronze script, jinwen.
china/xia-shang-zhou.1de0df3d62bb: The Zhou king handed out land and people to relatives and loyal generals, who ran their own small states and owed him soldiers and gifts. Europe’s feudal system, one thousand eight hundred years later, worked in a similar way.
china/xia-shang-zhou.3f311fa00542: The throne passes from father to son, or brother. Before that, legend says leaders chose the most able person to follow them, 禅让, “abdication”.
china/xia-shang-zhou.c2b83c99fe18: The Four-Ram Zun reaches about up to the student’s thigh. It is fifty-eight point three centimeters tall.
china/xia-shang-zhou.75e6bfde7d7e: About twenty seventy B C E Yu founded the Xia, China’s first dynasty. After Yu died his son Qi took the throne: hereditary rule replaced abdication — “shared by all” became “owned by one family”.
china/xia-shang-zhou.fb2cf2d7c6c4: About twenty seventy B C E Yu, 禹 — a hero remembered for taming great floods — founds the Xia. When he dies, his son Qi, 启, takes over. From now on the throne stays in one family.
china/xia-shang-zhou.65b940fd09a4: Copper melted together with tin. New bronze shines like gold; the green colour comes from three thousand years of rust.
china/xia-shang-zhou.6bc364cad9c6: Drag the slider from about twenty seventy B C E to seven hundred seventy B C E. Capitals, a battlefield and new states appear on the map as you go. Click any dot or coloured area, and check the side panel to see what was happening in the rest of the world at the same moment.
china/xia-shang-zhou.7eded00019e5: About thirteen hundred B C E King Pangeng, 盘庚, moves the capital to Yin, 殷, today’s Anyang. The Shang stay there about two hundred fifty years. This is where the oracle bones and the giant Houmuwu Ding were made.
china/xia-shang-zhou.adfef80f777f: Late Zhou kings grow greedy. In eight hundred forty-one B C E the people of the capital drive King Li, 周厉王, out — the first exactly dated year in Chinese history.
china/xia-shang-zhou.2c4770a8a053: Hold up eight hundred thirty-two kilograms — and leave room for a fire
china/xia-shang-zhou.0f37ae592b55: Aligned with the twenty twenty-two Compulsory Education History Curriculum Standard, Ancient China, “Xia, Shang and Zhou”, in summary: know the succession of Xia, Shang and Western Zhou; understand enfeoffment; learn the achievements of early states through oracle-bone script and bronzes. Textbook: Unified edition, Chinese History, Grade seven Volume.
china/xia-shang-zhou.41b474d71d1f: Watch the pictures slowly turn into today’s square characters: sun 日, moon 月, mountain 山, person 人, tree 木. Chinese characters have developed continuously for over three thousand years.
china/xia-shang-zhou.12b70dfaef28: Yin Ruins, Yinxu. Today: Anyang, Henan. Over one hundred fifty thousand oracle bones with the earliest Chinese writing were dug up here, and the eight hundred thirty-two kilogram Houmuwu Ding.
china/xia-shang-zhou.9f04fec67217: Luoyang. Thirteen dynasties made Luoyang their capital. Near the city, the Longmen Grottoes hold about one hundred thousand Buddhist statues carved into the cliffs.
china/xia-shang-zhou.2a148a99a54d: Ideas: one, use the time slider to explain the name “bronze”, 青铜: copper-tin alloy whose rust is green, as evidence work; two, turn on “Compare size” and ask how many people it took to cast the ding: evidence of advanced Shang bronze casting; three, after step two of the animation, debate whether hereditary rule was progress or regress, guide: it marks the birth of the early state.
china/xia-shang-zhou.c3842962c566: Why is it called “青铜”, green copper?
china/xia-shang-zhou.0ddd4b285cc6: Late Western Zhou rule decayed: in eight hundred forty-one B C E the people of the capital rose up. In seven hundred seventy-one B C E the Western Zhou fell. The next year, seven hundred seventy B C E, King Ping moved the capital east to Luoyi — the Eastern Zhou began.
china/xia-shang-zhou.3c7dff721668: The Houmuwu Ding is almost as tall as a middle-school student. It is one hundred thirty-three centimeters tall.
china/xia-shang-zhou.ac3a9b23bef9: Ding body and taotie pattern. A rectangular ritual cauldron of the late Shang. Cast in the late Shang dynasty; unearthed in nineteen thirty-nine at Anyang, Henan. It weighs eight hundred thirty-two point eight four kilograms and stands one hundred thirty-three centimeters tall: the heaviest ancient Chinese bronze yet found. The walls are covered with beast-face, taotie, patterns on a background of thunder-cloud spirals.
china/xia-shang-zhou.f4cd04ebcfb7: Eight hundred thirty-two point eight four kilograms, cast in the late Shang, unearthed at Anyang.
china/xia-shang-zhou.d0b0e4a18380: The last Xia king, Jie, 桀, is remembered as a cruel tyrant. About sixteen hundred B C E a leader named Tang, 汤, defeats him and founds the Shang dynasty.
china/xia-shang-zhou.bed1a25ac507: Four column legs. Hold up eight hundred thirty-two kilograms — and leave room for a fire. Four thick hollow column legs support the vessel. A ding was first a cooking pot; later bronze ding became ritual vessels and symbols of power. Each leg is decorated with a beast face near the top.
china/xia-shang-zhou.a80aaf061951: Cast in the late Shang dynasty; unearthed in nineteen thirty-nine at Anyang, Henan.

china/xia-shang-zhou.f4b5338d8bc1: The inner wall carries three characters: 后母戊, Hou Mu Wu.
china/xia-shang-zhou.05bb184204f2: Linzi. Today: Zibo, Shandong. One of the biggest cities in the world two thousand three hundred years ago — so crowded that “raising your sleeves makes shade”.
china/xia-shang-zhou.833b8aee5447: About ten forty-six B C E King Wu of Zhou, 周武王, marches east and beats the last Shang king, Zhou, 纣 — a different word from the dynasty’s name, at Muye. The new dynasty rules from Haojing and sends relatives and generals to run new states: enfeoffment.
china/xia-shang-zhou.d716b4900716: Common mix-up: “Bronze”, 青铜, is not “green copper”: it is a copper-tin alloy that was golden when new.

china/xia-shang-zhou.bc7673e2ab7f: In seven hundred seventy-one B C E invaders sack Haojing and the Western Zhou ends. Haojing is near Xi’an today. The next year King Ping, 周平王, moves the capital east to Luoyi, today’s Luoyang, about three hundred thirty kilometers away, or two hundred miles. The “Eastern Zhou” begins — see the next lesson.
china/xia-shang-zhou.28ba05207879: Late Shang dynasty; unearthed at Ningxiang, Hunan; fifty-eight point three centimeters tall.
china/xia-shang-zhou.caef772e2598: Three dynasties in a row: Xia from about twenty seventy to sixteen hundred B C E, Shang from about sixteen hundred to ten forty-six B C E, and Western Zhou from about ten forty-six to seven hundred seventy-one B C E.

china/xia-shang-zhou.a01766ecb82b: Erlitou. Today: Yanshi, Luoyang, Henan. Archaeologists found palace foundations, bronze workshops and a dragon made of over two thousand pieces of turquoise.

cs/cs-ai.810aa000d004: Same idea: features and labelled examples are used to build a model, which makes a prediction. Real image A I's use neural networks that find thousands of features in each  In Chinese, neural networks are called 神经网络. But they, too, only learn what is in their data.
cs/cs-ai.ecd8a66fc4da: Chatbots keep doing one thing: given the words so far, guess the most likely next word. These chatbots are large language models. Our tiny model read just fourteen sentences and only remembers which word follows which. Pick a start word, look at its predicted probabilities, then let it write.
cs/cs-ai.5ef30cff6b3d: China’s curriculum: Compulsory Education Information Technology Curriculum Standards, twenty twenty-two, stage four, grades seven to nine, grade-nine module “Artificial intelligence and the smart society”, how AI works, training data and models, uses, safety and ethics; learning strand “Artificial intelligence”, linked to the “Data” and “Algorithms” strands.
cs/cs-ai.c9eed1afc0a2: The AI can’t see fruit. It only gets two numbers — features, 特征: size and colour. Each dot is one fruit. You label examples; when a new fruit arrives, the AI finds the k closest examples and lets them vote. That is the k-nearest-neighbour algorithm, k N N. The background colours are its “map” of what it would guess anywhere.
cs/cs-ai.063fd04a3f6f: With k equals one, one mislabelled example near a test fruit will…
cs/cs-ai.4e73af3441c4: Your phone can tell a cat from a dog in a photo — yet nobody ever wrote it a rule for “cat”. So how does it know? It looked at thousands of examples and found the pattern itself. That is machine learning, 机器学习. Today, you are the trainer.
cs/cs-ai.f2e1ed9628dc: With k equals one, the AI trusts only its single closest example — one mislabelled dot can fool it. With k equals five, five neighbours vote, so a few mistakes get outvoted. But if k is too big, borders blur and small groups get swamped by big ones.
cs/cs-ai.1c071e325fb4: Chart reading: between twenty eleven and twenty twelve the winning error dropped from about twenty-six percent to sixteen percent. What changed?
cs/cs-ai.5e14b3af2a16: Deep Blue beat the chess champion in nineteen ninety-seven mainly by…
cs/cs-ai.ac45efa236f5: The ImageNet challenge: show a computer one hundred thousand photos it has never seen and ask it to name the object out of one thousand categories, five guesses allowed. Drag the slider to read each year’s winning error rate. In twenty twelve a neural network won for the first time, using deep learning — and errors dropped sharply.
cs/cs-ai.5480c760fabc: U S standards: C S T A K to twelve C S Standards, twenty seventeen: two dash I C dash two zero, compare tradeoffs of computing technologies in everyday life and careers; two dash I C dash two one, discuss bias and accessibility in the design of existing technologies; two dash D A dash zero nine, refine computational models based on the data they generate; two dash A P dash one seven, systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.
cs/cs-ai.d6a39692a08b: Learns from data, AI or machine learning
cs/cs-ai.bf5b9745ee4b: Data: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge winning results twenty ten to twenty seventeen, I L S V R C, Russakovsky et al., twenty fifteen, and published yearly results, rounded — approximate. The human “about five percent” is one researcher’s own twenty fourteen test, an estimate rather than a precise measurement.
cs/cs-ai.3a55139e0af4: Twenty fourteen: six point seven percent; twenty fifteen: about three point six percent, ResNet.
cs/cs-ai.cb517be43912: It only knows how words link, not what sentences mean or whether they’re true. “The moon is a planet” is a smooth chain of likely words — and false. Real chatbots learned from trillions of words, so they sound far more human, but they can still invent confident, wrong answers — called hallucination, 幻觉. Check important facts in reliable sources.
cs/cs-ai.934b0fd3d9a3: searching about two hundred million positions per second
cs/cs-ai.fb89e0088002: A bigger k lets the neighbours outvote a few bad labels — for example, a k of five.
cs/cs-ai.20c9d04475bc: Ours looks back one word and stores a few dozen pairs. A large language model uses a neural network that looks back over thousands of tokens, with billions to trillions of parameters — tokens in Chinese, 词元. Same core job: predict the next token.
cs/cs-ai.372979a0e519: Training data are the labelled examples you give the AI to learn from — training data in Chinese, 训练数据. The test set is sixty-four other fruit it has never seen. Only a good score on the test set shows it really learned — and didn’t just memorise.
cs/cs-ai.4547f98fc253: Georgia K to twelve Computer Science Standards, six to eight, for example C S S dot C T dot six dash eight dot four zero dot one, distinguish human from machine intelligence; C S S dot C T dot six dash eight dot four zero dot two, describe how computers model intelligent behaviour — robot motion, speech, vision — and how that differs from human reasoning; C S S dot K C dot six dash eight dot two zero dot three, how computers represent data. Codes as listed in G A D O E’s six to eight C S framework, via Code H S;
cs/cs-ai.a9aaf7cbc936: Don’t mix up: Scoring one hundred percent on its own training examples is not equal to “learned”. An AI can “memorise” the examples and still fail on new data, overfitting, 过拟合. Always test it on data it hasn’t seen.
cs/cs-ai.93c211e40f16: Chart reading: in which year did the ImageNet winner first get below the about five percent human estimate?
cs/cs-ai.dcee9bb66ae0: Notes: the fruit data are invented teaching data, two features so the space can be seen on a flat map; the classifier is a real K N N and the sixty-four-fruit test set is fixed. The next-word model is a real bigram model. ImageNet values are the published yearly winners, approximate; the about five percent human figure is a single-person estimate.

cs/cs-algorithms.75501029ec22: Bubble sort. Walk along the list comparing neighbours; swap them if they are in the wrong order. Big values “bubble” to the end. Compare items one and two, swap if needed; then two and three; … to the end. After one pass the biggest item is in its place. Repeat passes until a pass makes no swaps. Worst case for n items: n times the quantity n minus one, over two comparisons — ten items equals forty-five, one thousand items about five hundred thousand.
cs/cs-algorithms.8e1be689c63e: China’s curriculum: Compulsory Education Information Technology Curriculum Standard, twenty twenty-two, core strand “algorithms”, 算法. Stage three, grade five module “Algorithms around us”, 身边的算法: describe algorithms in words and flowcharts, feel the difference in efficiency, for example searching and sorting; Stage four applies algorithms in programming projects, in grades seven to nine. Textbook editions and lesson numbers vary.
cs/cs-algorithms.0d2759a4600e: Each box holds a different weight, but you can’t see it. Click two boxes to put them on the scale, one comparison; press Swap to switch their places. Put the boxes in order from light to heavy, left to right, then check. Fewer comparisons equals more stars.
cs/cs-algorithms.5fe927277f1c: Binary search. In a sorted list, look at the middle item. Too big? Throw away the right half. Too small? Throw away the left half. Repeat. Each guess halves what is left: one hundred, fifty, twenty-five, thirteen, seven, four, two, one. At most seven guesses for one hundred, ten for one thousand, twenty for one million. Doubling the list adds only ONE more guess.

cs/cs-algorithms.d1c36a9e22db: Data: worst-case step counts calculated from the formulas — linear search n, binary search the ceiling of log base two of the quantity n plus one, bubble sort n times the quantity n minus one, divided by two comparisons, merge sort about n times log base two of n comparisons.

cs/cs-algorithms.676109808b4b: Breadth-first search. Explore a maze like a spreading wave: first every square one step away, then two steps, then three… The first time the wave reaches the exit, that is the shortest path. Needs a map of the whole maze, the robot’s rules don’t. GPS route planners use relatives of this idea, like Dijkstra’s algorithm.
cs/cs-algorithms.0d2647585beb: Merge sort. Split the list into tiny pieces, then merge pieces back together in order — two sorted piles merge quickly. A list of one item is already sorted. Merge pairs of one into sorted twos, then twos into fours, fours into eights…. To merge, compare the fronts of two piles and take the smaller. About n times log base two of n comparisons: one thousand items about ten thousand instead of five hundred thousand.
cs/cs-algorithms.04d3d4dafb95: Bubble sort, about five hundred billion
cs/cs-algorithms.10416eef7d49: Bad luck: if the pivot is always the biggest or smallest, it needs n times the quantity n minus one, divided by two — O of n squared. Try Already sorted!
cs/cs-algorithms.eaf204585dbf: A search engine finds answers among billions of pages in under a second. That takes more than a fast computer — it takes a smart algorithm: a step-by-step method for solving a problem. How big is the gap between a smart and a slow algorithm? Finding one name among a million: the slow way can take a million looks; the smart way never needs more than twenty.
cs/cs-algorithms.da975dc65d13: Reversed list: n times the quantity n minus one, divided by two comparisons — the worst case, O of n squared.

cs/cs-algorithms.0490fd27687f: n equals twenty-four: n times the quantity n minus one, divided by two equals twenty-four times twenty-three divided by two equals two hundred seventy-six; n times log base two of n equals twenty-four times four point six, about one hundred ten. Big-O keeps only the fastest-growing part: when n doubles, n squared grows times four but n times log n only a bit more than times two.
cs/cs-algorithms.c1032811e8f4: Quick sort. Pick a “pivot”, here: the last item. Move everything smaller to its left, everything bigger to its right. Then quick-sort each side. One pass around the pivot puts the pivot in its final place. Each side is a smaller problem: divide and conquer, like merge sort, but in place. Average: about one point four times n times log base two of n comparisons — O of n log n. Bad luck: if the pivot is always the biggest or smallest — try “Already sorted” — it needs n times the quantity n minus one, over two — O of n squared.

cs/cs-algorithms.36aa2341e71a: Notes: in the race, “steps” equals comparisons plus moves, swaps or writes; bubble sort stops early when a pass makes no swaps; merge sort is the bottom-up version. The chart shows worst-case counts from formulas, not measured times; “one billion steps per second” is only an assumption for comparison.
cs/cs-algorithms.f78f4c96f8cf: Don’t mix up: Selection sort makes few swaps, at most n minus one, but it never gets to skip comparisons.
cs/cs-algorithms.01e6fe439f4b: Linear search. Check items one by one from the start until you find what you want. Works on any list, sorted or not. Worst case: n looks, the item is last or missing. Control plus F in a document is a kind of linear search.
cs/cs-algorithms.3babc464665a: Selection sort. Find the smallest item and put it first; then find the smallest of the rest and put it second; and so on. Scan the whole unsorted part to find the smallest. Swap it to the front of the unsorted part. The sorted part grows by one each round. Always about n times the quantity n minus one, over two comparisons, even if the list was already sorted.

cs/cs-algorithms.5311a5fbb676: Insertion sort. Like sorting playing cards in your hand: take the next card and slide it left until it sits in the right place. earth/atmosphere.5ff8112541e6: Ozone layer. Earth’s sunscreen, about fifteen to thirty-five kilometers. A zone inside the stratosphere where ozone gas is most concentrated. Ozone gas is O three. Ozone absorbs most of the Sun’s harmful ultraviolet rays, or U V rays, protecting living things from sunburn, skin cancer and eye damage. Chemicals called CFCs, once used in spray cans and refrigerators, thinned it, causing the “ozone hole” over Antarctica. A nineteen eighty-seven treaty called the Montreal Protocol began phasing them out; they are now banned almost everywhere, and the layer is slowly healing.

earth/atmosphere.7782d1c65755: Troposphere. Zero to twelve kilometers, where weather happens. The lowest layer: about eight kilometers thick over the poles and sixteen to eighteen kilometers thick over the equator. It holds about seventy-five to eighty percent of all the air and almost all the water vapor, so nearly all clouds, rain and storms form here. Temperature drops about six point five degrees Celsius for every kilometer you climb, because this layer is heated from the ground below. Air here keeps mixing by convection: warm air rises and cool air sinks.
earth/atmosphere.d1a5672cda6a: Mesosphere. Fifty to eighty-five kilometers, meteors burn up here. The coldest layer: about minus ninety degrees Celsius near its top. Most meteors, “shooting stars”, burn up here as they rub against air molecules at high speed. Too high for planes and balloons, too low for satellites, so it is the least explored layer.
earth/atmosphere.eabcd2d3f7a7: Global winds. Uneven heating and Earth’s spin. The Sun heats the equator more than the poles. Warm air rises at the equator and cooler air flows in to replace it, forming giant convection loops. Earth’s rotation bends moving air, a phenomenon called the Coriolis effect, so winds blow at an angle instead of straight north-south. Trade winds blow from the east toward the equator, in the band from zero to thirty degrees; prevailing westerlies blow from the west, in the band from thirty to sixty degrees; polar easterlies blow from the east, in the band from sixty to ninety degrees. The westerlies carry most weather across the United States from west to east.

Toward the poles the same beam hits at a low angle and spreads over a bigger area, so each square meter gets less energy.
